title: an unwrap in a loop header is rejected: per-iteration propagation needs control-flow lowering
notes: poc/src/language/README.md: 'Repeated loop-header unwrap is explicitly rejected' and 'Result.unwrap() in a loop condition, incrementor, or iteration expression needs per-iteration control-flow lowering.' The underlying obligation is specification/failures.mdx, 'Propagation': 'The emitted error path MUST return the enclosing error variant rather than throw a recoverable JavaScript exception.' A loop header is evaluated once per iteration, so an early-return lowering placed before the loop would change the program's meaning; fail-closed is the only sound answer until a checked control-flow IR exists.
